title: Build visible local MAP Steward attention assistant
description: Build the operator-approved local Jarvis-style MAP Steward. Combine deterministic health/task/RnS/E-I/lesson signals into a read-only attention packet, optionally ask local Ollama qwen3.5:4b to summarize that bounded packet, and expose status, last run, recommendations, errors, model use, and controls through the Command Center UI. The steward is advisory: it cannot edit code/policy, approve/promote, claim tasks, message the operator autonomously, or spawn agents. Every model-backed interactive/curation session remains visible in wezterm-tab; no headless/background agent is allowed.
acceptance_criteria: Deterministically aggregates actionable task/review queues, agent availability/RnS, active operational lessons, and E/I sentinel candidates into a bounded attention packet.
Optional qwen3.5:4b interpretation receives only the bounded packet and produces advisory structured output; deterministic fallback works when Ollama is unavailable or times out.
Command Center visibly shows steward status, last run, inputs, recommendations, model/fallback mode, errors, and explicit refresh/stop controls.
The steward cannot mutate tasks, policy, E/I promotion state, approvals, agent sessions, or operator messages; every model-backed working session follows the visible-terminal rule.
Focused unit/integration tests pass, including malformed model output, Ollama failure, privacy/source bounds, and no-action guarantees; task graph and mirrors validate.
